title: Where can I find the video link?
summary: Where to find TheySix videos and the link needed to get their files.

body.content: Find the video that shows the farm or build you want. The video description can contain the video link, the Download Number, and links to the files.

items.content: Open the channel that matches the video you are looking for.
Open the full description below the video.
Copy the video link or the DN from the description.

body.content: Use the DN with the [Download Number guide](https://wiki-theysix.ro-mihaiu.xyz/w/discord/what-is-download-number) to find the schematic or world file.
